page: Microsoft Azure L160ias_v5 is an isolated virtual machine instance belonging to the Lasv5 server family. Powered by x86_64 AMD processors, this instance features 160 dedicated virtual CPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 1280.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A defining characteristic of the L160ias_v5 is its substantial local storage capacity, offering 30718 GB of Premium Storage-capable local disk space. This instance does not include any integrated graphics processing units, making it entirely reliant on its 160 dedicated AMD CPU cores for all computational tasks. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the L160ias_v5 offers high storage-to-compute and memory-to-compute ratios, positioning it as a specialized option for workloads requiring massive local data footprints and large memory capacities. The primary tradeoff is the lack of hardware acceleration, which limits its utility for deep learning or graphics-heavy tasks. The instance is designed for large-scale database deployments, big data analytics, and memory-intensive storage workloads that benefit from isolated physical hardware resources.
